devdoc.details: Non-custodial helper constructs only fixed single-pool routes. No delegatecall.

buy(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256).details: minOut and minBuyAmount apply before the optional sell probe. The retained share of that minimum also protects the recipient's final receipt. With a 100% sell probe no output token is sent; recovered input stays in this contract. A fresh owner-signed buy is allowed while disarmed. All old epochs are invalid.

buy(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: amountIn=0 spends the entire prefunded input-token balance.

depositNative().notice: Wraps only this call's msg.value; pre-existing ETH is not swept.

setTriggerWallets(address[],bool).notice: Both grants and revocations invalidate the old armed task. Re-arming must be a separate explicit owner transaction after confirmation.

simulateTaxSaved(uint256,uint16).notice: Revert-only actual path measurement. Outer frame exclusively creates TaxReport.

withdrawToken(address,address,uint256).notice: Recovery does not depend on DEX, quotes, metadata, task or expiry. amount=0 reads the entire balance; explicit raw amount does not call balanceOf. Only the owner can choose the recipient. Trigger wallets cannot withdraw.

userdoc.notice: V4-only prefunded executor. Immutable owner and protocol addresses.
